device.name: Hikvision IP Camera / NVR (ISAPI)
device.notes:
Hikvision cameras and NVRs expose ISAPI — a REST/XML HTTP API — plus RTSP, controllable locally with no Hik-Connect cloud (relevant given Hikvision's US NDAA restrictions).
PORTS: HTTP 80 (default), RTSP 554. AUTH: Basic and Digest.
ISAPI (REST/XML over HTTP, resources under /ISAPI/...):
  /ISAPI/System/deviceInfo                          device info
  /ISAPI/Streaming/channels                         channel list
  /ISAPI/Streaming/channels/102/picture             per-channel still (1xx
                                                    main, 1x2 sub)
  /ISAPI/System/Video/inputs/channels/1/motionDetection   motion config
  /ISAPI/Event/notification/alertStream             long-lived event stream

RTSP live: rtsp://{ip}:554/Streaming/Channels/101 (channel 1, last digit 1 = main / 2 = sub).
Discovery: ONVIF (Profile S/T) WS-Discovery (see onvif.yaml), Hikvision's own SADP, or a direct ISAPI probe on port 80.

openness.notes: ISAPI is Hikvision's documented (if partly gated) REST/XML API; the full resource tree is large and only the cited subset is documented here. See onvif.yaml for ONVIF discovery/streaming.

credentials.notes: Local control uses the camera's admin credential over Basic/Digest. Activation/onboarding is via SADP/web UI and not documented here.

factory_reset.effect: Clears config and the admin password, returning the camera to the unactivated state. Performed by holding the reset button; the hold time is model-specific.

procedures.basis: Hikvision documents a reset-button hold per model; not replayed here.
procedures.name: Reset button hold

steps.action: Hold the camera's reset button until it reboots into the unactivated state.
steps.expect: The camera returns to first-boot (requires re-activation).

methods.description: Activate the camera (set a strong admin password) via SADP or the web UI, then use ISAPI over HTTP Digest and pull RTSP from port 554.

steps.action: Activate the camera and set an admin password (SADP or web UI).
Use ISAPI (Digest) and read RTSP from /Streaming/Channels/101.

setup.notes: The camera is activated with a strong admin password on first use (via SADP or the web UI); local ISAPI over Digest thereafter, no cloud. Provisioning wire steps are not documented here.

rejoin.notes: Network settings are changed from the camera UI / ISAPI while reachable.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The ISAPI paths, the RTSP channel URL, ports and auth are from maciej-or/hikvision_next and the hikvisionapi PyPI client.
